states.caption: Running through the level: a coin every 2 s, energy refilling.
A hit every second from full health: a cell breaks, the panel shakes.

a.name: Panel
a.note: Health cells, coins and energy grouped on one panel, top left; the ability slot bottom right.

b.name: Minimal
b.note: No panel: bigger cells straight on the screen, a thin energy bar under them.

recommend.why: The panel keeps the HUD readable over busy backgrounds.
